caption: The drawing depicts a large wooden armoire or wardrobe placed in front of two windows. The armoire is a medium brown color and features two tall doors on the upper section and four drawers on the lower portion, each with round, light-colored knobs. The legs of the armoire are short and slightly curved. The two windows positioned behind the armoire have blue frames and multiple panes, arranged in a grid pattern. The wall is off-white with a horizontal brown molding near the floor, and the floor itself is a light tan color. The drawing appears to be rendered with careful attention to the straight lines and geometric forms of both the windows and the armoire, with the signature "Geo. J. Vezolles" in the bottom right corner.
title: Shaker Cupboard
